answer: Each agent locks tokens behind peers it has transacted with, forming a trellis of trust where every new identity needs real sponsors with skin in the game. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted vouching. A sybil farm must convince existing staked participants to risk slashing, which is costly and traceable. Isolated clusters stay quarantined like a walled garden until they earn cross-links, while honest newcomers find an oasis of cheap entry through small vouches that grow with reputation.
